    c_rCycleDeltaT_s                : REAL := 0.10;     (* Periodic scan cycle duration (100 ms) [s] *)

    (* Temporary Loop Counters and Calculations *)
    iIdx                            : INT;
    jIdx                            : INT;
    rTempTerm                       : REAL;
    rAntoineLogP                    : REAL;
    rDeltaCurrent                   : REAL;
    rDeltaVacSpeed                  : REAL;
    rDeltaPumpSpeed                 : REAL;
    rNetGrossPower_kW               : REAL;
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC LOGIC EXECUTION ROUTINE (SAMPLE TIME Ts = 100 ms)
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & CRITICAL TRIP HIERARCHY (SIL-3 LEVEL)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Reset internal alarm latches if requested and safe *)
IF bResetFaults THEN
    wAlarmWord1 := 16#0000;
    wAlarmWord2 := 16#0000;
    bSystemAlarm := FALSE;
    bSystemWarning := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* SIL-3 Master Emergency Stop Interlock: Deterministic Immediate System De-Energization *)
IF NOT bEStopOk THEN
    rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
    rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct     := 0.0;
    rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct    := 100.0;   (* Fully open bleed valve to vent chamber *)
    rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct    := 0.0;
    rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio     := 0.0;
    bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd        := FALSE;
    bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd      := FALSE;
    bVacuumPumpTrainCmd         := FALSE;
    bCondenserChillerCmd        := FALSE;
    bVacuumBreakValveCmd        := TRUE;    (* Fast nitrogen / atmospheric vacuum break *)
    bEffluentDischargeDivertCmd := TRUE;    (* Divert discharge away from ocean *)

    wAlarmWord1.0               := TRUE;    (* E-Stop Trip Active *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord           := 16#F000;
    iState                      := 999;     (* Jump immediately to failsafe emergency state *)
    iSequenceStep               := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Hydrogen Flammability Interlock in Electrode Rinse Off-Gas *)
IF (rBMED_H2Concentration_pctLEL >= c_rCriticalH2_pctLEL) THEN
    rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
    bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd      := TRUE;    (* Keep circulating rinse to purge gas *)
    wAlarmWord1.1               := TRUE;    (* Critical H2 LEL trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    iState                      := 999;
ELSIF (rBMED_H2Concentration_pctLEL >= c_rWarningH2_pctLEL) THEN
    wAlarmWord2.0               := TRUE;    (* H2 LEL warning advisory *)
    bSystemWarning              := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* BMED Membrane Stack Bulk Thermal Runaway Protection *)
IF (rBMED_StackTemp_degC >= c_rMaxStackTemp_degC) THEN
    rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord1.2               := TRUE;    (* Membrane stack overtemperature trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    iState                      := 999;
END_IF;

(* BMED DC Stack Overvoltage / Membrane Delamination Arc Prevention *)
IF (rBMED_StackVoltage_V >= c_rMaxStackVoltage_V) THEN
    rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord1.3               := TRUE;    (* Stack overvoltage trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    iState                      := 999;
END_IF;

(* Flash Stripper Sump Low-Low Level Cavitation Protection *)
IF (iState >= 40) AND (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m <= 0.18) THEN
    rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct    := 0.0;     (* Inhibit bottoms pump to prevent dry run cavitation *)
    wAlarmWord1.5               := TRUE;    (* Sump low-low level trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    iState                      := 900;     (* Divert to safe recirculation mode *)
END_IF;

(* Flash Stripper Sump High-High Level Condenser Flood Prevention *)
IF (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m >= 1.35) THEN
    rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct    := 100.0;   (* Maximize evacuation speed *)
    wAlarmWord1.6               := TRUE;    (* Sump high-high level alarm *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    iState                      := 900;
END_IF;

(* Marine Effluent Neutralization Discharge Violation Interlock *)
IF (iState >= 50) AND ((rDischargeEffluentPH_pH < 6.50) OR (rDischargeEffluentPH_pH > 8.50)) THEN
    bEffluentDischargeDivertCmd := TRUE;    (* Divert to environmental holding pond *)
    wAlarmWord1.7               := TRUE;    (* Ocean permit pH excursion *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
ELSE
    bEffluentDischargeDivertCmd := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Electrode Rinse Loop Flow Loss Protection *)
IF (bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd) AND (rBMED_ElectrodeRinseFlow_m3h < 1.50) AND (iState >= 20) THEN
    rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord1.8               := TRUE;    (* Electrode rinse flow lost *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    iState                      := 999;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- ENGINE 1: FLASH STRIPPER VACUUM PRESSURE (PT-101A, PT-101B, PT-101C) --- *)
(* Physical Boundary Validation [5.0 .. 1100.0 mbar abs] *)
bPT_ChanA_Valid := (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar >= 5.0) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar <= 1100.0);
bPT_ChanB_Valid := (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar >= 5.0) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar <= 1100.0);
bPT_ChanC_Valid := (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar >= 5.0) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar <= 1100.0);

(* Pairwise Discrepancy Computation *)
rDiff_PT_AB := ABS(rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar - rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar);
rDiff_PT_BC := ABS(rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar - rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar);
rDiff_PT_CA := ABS(rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar - rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar);

(* Discrepancy Timers for Sensor Drift Identification (2.0 s persistence threshold) *)
tPT_DevTimer_A(IN := (rDiff_PT_AB > c_rPT_MaxDeviation_mbar) AND (rDiff_PT_CA > c_rPT_MaxDeviation_mbar), PT := T#2S);
tPT_DevTimer_B(IN := (rDiff_PT_AB > c_rPT_MaxDeviation_mbar) AND (rDiff_PT_BC > c_rPT_MaxDeviation_mbar), PT := T#2S);
tPT_DevTimer_C(IN := (rDiff_PT_BC > c_rPT_MaxDeviation_mbar) AND (rDiff_PT_CA > c_rPT_MaxDeviation_mbar), PT := T#2S);

IF tPT_DevTimer_A.Q THEN bPT_ChanA_Valid := FALSE; wAlarmWord2.2 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF tPT_DevTimer_B.Q THEN bPT_ChanB_Valid := FALSE; wAlarmWord2.3 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF tPT_DevTimer_C.Q THEN bPT_ChanC_Valid := FALSE; wAlarmWord2.4 := TRUE; END_IF;

(* Sensor Health Counting *)
iHealthyPTCount := 0;
IF bPT_ChanA_Valid THEN iHealthyPTCount := iHealthyPTCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPT_ChanB_Valid THEN iHealthyPTCount := iHealthyPTCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPT_ChanC_Valid THEN iHealthyPTCount := iHealthyPTCount + 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 / 1oo2 Voting Resolution *)
IF (iHealthyPTCount = 3) THEN
    (* All channels healthy: Select True Median *)
    IF ((rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar >= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar <= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar)) OR
       ((rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar <= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar >= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar)) THEN
        rVotedFlashPress_mbar := rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar;
    ELSIF ((rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar >= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar <= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar)) OR
          ((rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar <= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar >= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar)) THEN
        rVotedFlashPress_mbar := rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar;
    ELSE
        rVotedFlashPress_mbar := rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;
ELSIF (iHealthyPTCount = 2) THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 operation: Arithmetic average of remaining healthy channels *)
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    IF bPT_ChanA_Valid AND bPT_ChanB_Valid THEN
        rVotedFlashPress_mbar := 0.5 * (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar + rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar);
    ELSIF bPT_ChanB_Valid AND bPT_ChanC_Valid THEN
        rVotedFlashPress_mbar := 0.5 * (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar + rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar);
    ELSE
        rVotedFlashPress_mbar := 0.5 * (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar + rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar);
    END_IF;
ELSIF (iHealthyPTCount = 1) THEN
    (* Critical degraded fallback: Use sole surviving channel and trigger high-priority warning *)
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2.9 := TRUE;
    IF bPT_ChanA_Valid THEN rVotedFlashPress_mbar := rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar;
    ELSIF bPT_ChanB_Valid THEN rVotedFlashPress_mbar := rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar;
    ELSE rVotedFlashPress_mbar := rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total sensor divergence/failure: Immediate fail-safe abort *)
    wAlarmWord1.9 := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm  := TRUE;
    iState        := 999;
END_IF;


(* --- ENGINE 2: ACIDIFIED SEAWATER PH (AT-201A, AT-201B, AT-201C) --- *)
(* Physical Boundary Validation [1.0 .. 13.0 pH] *)
bPH_ChanA_Valid := (rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH >= 1.0) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH <= 13.0);
bPH_ChanB_Valid := (rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH >= 1.0) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH <= 13.0);
bPH_ChanC_Valid := (rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH >= 1.0) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH <= 13.0);

(* Pairwise Discrepancy Computation *)
rDiff_PH_AB := ABS(rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH - rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH);
rDiff_PH_BC := ABS(rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH - rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH);
rDiff_PH_CA := ABS(rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH - rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH);

tPH_DevTimer_A(IN := (rDiff_PH_AB > c_rPH_MaxDeviation_pH) AND (rDiff_PH_CA > c_rPH_MaxDeviation_pH), PT := T#2S);
tPH_DevTimer_B(IN := (rDiff_PH_AB > c_rPH_MaxDeviation_pH) AND (rDiff_PH_BC > c_rPH_MaxDeviation_pH), PT := T#2S);
tPH_DevTimer_C(IN := (rDiff_PH_BC > c_rPH_MaxDeviation_pH) AND (rDiff_PH_CA > c_rPH_MaxDeviation_pH), PT := T#2S);

IF tPH_DevTimer_A.Q THEN bPH_ChanA_Valid := FALSE; wAlarmWord2.5 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF tPH_DevTimer_B.Q THEN bPH_ChanB_Valid := FALSE; wAlarmWord2.6 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF tPH_DevTimer_C.Q THEN bPH_ChanC_Valid := FALSE; wAlarmWord2.7 := TRUE; END_IF;

iHealthyPHCount := 0;
IF bPH_ChanA_Valid THEN iHealthyPHCount := iHealthyPHCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPH_ChanB_Valid THEN iHealthyPHCount := iHealthyPHCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPH_ChanC_Valid THEN iHealthyPHCount := iHealthyPHCount + 1; END_IF;

IF (iHealthyPHCount = 3) THEN
    IF ((rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH >= rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH <= rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH)) OR
       ((rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH <= rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH >= rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH)) THEN
        rVotedAcidPH_pH := rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH;
    ELSIF ((rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH >= rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH <= rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH)) OR
          ((rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH <= rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH >= rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH)) THEN
        rVotedAcidPH_pH := rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH;
    ELSE
        rVotedAcidPH_pH := rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (iHealthyPHCount = 2) THEN
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    IF bPH_ChanA_Valid AND bPH_ChanB_Valid THEN
        rVotedAcidPH_pH := 0.5 * (rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH + rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH);
    ELSIF bPH_ChanB_Valid AND bPH_ChanC_Valid THEN
        rVotedAcidPH_pH := 0.5 * (rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH + rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH);
    ELSE
        rVotedAcidPH_pH := 0.5 * (rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH + rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH);
    END_IF;
ELSIF (iHealthyPHCount = 1) THEN
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    IF bPH_ChanA_Valid THEN rVotedAcidPH_pH := rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH;
    ELSIF bPH_ChanB_Valid THEN rVotedAcidPH_pH := rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH;
    ELSE rVotedAcidPH_pH := rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    wAlarmWord1.10 := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm   := TRUE;
    iState         := 999;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: THERMODYNAMIC, CHEMICAL SPECIATION & MEMBRANE RESISTANCE ANALYTICS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Real-time Antoine Saturated Vapor Pressure of Seawater: log10(P_sat [mmHg]) = 8.07131 - 1730.63 / (T + 233.426) *)
rTempTerm := rSeawaterIntakeTemp_degC + 233.426;
IF (rTempTerm > 50.0) THEN
    rAntoineLogP := 8.07131 - (1730.63 / rTempTerm);
    (* Convert mmHg to mbar (1 mmHg = 1.33322 mbar) and correct for seawater salinity osmotic depression *)
    rWaterVaporSaturationPress_mbar := EXPT(10.0, rAntoineLogP) * 1.33322 * (1.0 - 0.000537 * rSeawaterIntakeSalinity_PSU);
ELSE
    rWaterVaporSaturationPress_mbar := 23.4;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Vacuum Low-Limit Floor to Prevent Catastrophic Steam Flash Runaway *)
rMinPermissibleFlashPress_mbar := rWaterVaporSaturationPress_mbar + c_rChokingMargin_mbar;

(* Interlock: Trip vacuum train if operating chamber pressure breaches boiling runaway threshold *)
IF (iState >= 40) AND (rVotedFlashPress_mbar <= (rWaterVaporSaturationPress_mbar + 5.0)) THEN
    rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct  := 0.0;
    rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct := 100.0;  (* Immediate pressure relief *)
    wAlarmWord1.4            := TRUE;   (* Water boiling flashover trip *)
    bSystemAlarm             := TRUE;
    iState                   := 900;    (* Divert to safe recirculation mode *)
END_IF;

(* Temperature and Salinity Dependent Henry Solubility Coefficient H_CO2(T, S) [mol/kg/bar] *)
rHenrysConstant_mol_kg_bar := 0.0345 * EXP(-0.024 * (rSeawaterIntakeTemp_degC - 20.0)) * (1.0 - 0.0035 * (rSeawaterIntakeSalinity_PSU - 35.0));

(* Carbonic Acid Bjerrum Speciation Fraction: alpha_CO2 = [CO2*] / DIC = 1 / (1 + 10^(pH - pK1) + 10^(2pH - pK1 - pK2)) *)
IF (rVotedAcidPH_pH <= 4.0) THEN
    rCarbonicDissociationRatio := 0.985;
ELSIF (rVotedAcidPH_pH <= 5.0) THEN
    rCarbonicDissociationRatio := 0.920;
ELSIF (rVotedAcidPH_pH <= 6.0) THEN
    rCarbonicDissociationRatio := 0.650;
ELSE
    rCarbonicDissociationRatio := 0.150;
END_IF;

(* BMED Stack Apparent Resistance & Area-Specific Resistance (ASR) Tracking *)
IF (rBMED_StackCurrent_A > 5.0) THEN
    rBMED_ApparentResistance_Ohm    := rBMED_StackVoltage_V / rBMED_StackCurrent_A;
    rBMED_AreaSpecificResist_Ohm_m2 := (rBMED_ApparentResistance_Ohm * (c_rStackActiveCellPairs * c_rMembraneActiveArea_m2)) / c_rStackActiveCellPairs;

    (* Mineral Scaling Detection: Brucite Mg(OH)2 or Aragonite CaCO3 Precipitation *)
    IF (rBMED_AreaSpecificResist_Ohm_m2 >= (rBaselineASR_Ohm_m2 * 1.35)) THEN
        bMembraneScaleDetected := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord2.1          := TRUE;    (* Membrane scaling warning *)
        bSystemWarning         := TRUE;
    ELSE
        bMembraneScaleDetected := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rBMED_ApparentResistance_Ohm    := 0.0;
    rBMED_AreaSpecificResist_Ohm_m2 := rBaselineASR_Ohm_m2;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time CO2 Gas Harvesting Mass Rate Calculation [kg/h] *)
rEstimatedCO2CaptureRate_kgh := rGaseousCO2Flow_Nm3h * (rGaseousCO2Purity_pct / 100.0) * (c_rCO2MolarMass_g_mol / 22.414);

(* Real-Time Net Specific Energy Consumption [kWh / tCO2] *)
IF (rEstimatedCO2CaptureRate_kgh > 5.0) THEN
    rNetGrossPower_kW := ((rBMED_StackVoltage_V * rBMED_StackCurrent_A) / 1000.0) + (rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct * 0.45) + (rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct * 0.15);
    rSpecificEnergy_kWh_tCO2 := (rNetGrossPower_kW / (rEstimatedCO2CaptureRate_kgh / 1000.0));
    IF (rSpecificEnergy_kWh_tCO2 > 350.0) THEN
        wAlarmWord2.10 := TRUE; (* Specific energy consumption high advisory *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rSpecificEnergy_kWh_tCO2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: STATE-SPACE PREDICTIVE CONTROLLER & FEEDFORWARD DECOUPLING (MPC KERNEL)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Measurable External Disturbance Vector: d = [Delta Q_sw, Delta T_sw]^T *)
rDisturbance_DeltaQ_m3h  := rSeawaterInflowRate_m3h - c_rNominalInflow_m3h;
rDisturbance_DeltaT_degC := rSeawaterIntakeTemp_degC - c_rNominalTemp_degC;

(* System State Error Deviation Vector: e(k) = x_ref - x_actual *)
aStateDeviation[1] := rTargetAcidPH_pH - rVotedAcidPH_pH;
aStateDeviation[2] := rTargetFlashPress_mbar - rVotedFlashPress_mbar;
aStateDeviation[3] := rTargetSumpLevel_m - rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m;
aStateDeviation[4] := (rSeawaterInflowRate_m3h * 2.15 * 0.04401 * 0.90) - rEstimatedCO2CaptureRate_kgh;

(* 1-Step Ahead State Prediction: x_pred(k+1) = A_d * x(k) + B_d_mat * u(k) + B_dist * d(k) *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStatePrediction[iIdx] := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        aStatePrediction[iIdx] := aStatePrediction[iIdx] + aMatrix_A_d[iIdx, jIdx] * aStateDeviation[jIdx];
    END_FOR;
    (* Add input coupling *)
    aStatePrediction[iIdx] := aStatePrediction[iIdx] + aMatrix_B_d[iIdx, 1] * aControlIncrement[1]
                                                    + aMatrix_B_d[iIdx, 2] * aControlIncrement[2]
                                                    + aMatrix_B_d[iIdx, 3] * aControlIncrement[3];
    (* Add external disturbance coupling *)
    aStatePrediction[iIdx] := aStatePrediction[iIdx] + aMatrix_B_dist[iIdx, 1] * rDisturbance_DeltaQ_m3h
                                                    + aMatrix_B_dist[iIdx, 2] * rDisturbance_DeltaT_degC;
END_FOR;

(* MPC Deadbeat/Horizon Optimal Control Increment Computation: Delta u = K_mpc * e(k) + K_ff * d(k) *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    aControlIncrement[iIdx] := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        aControlIncrement[iIdx] := aControlIncrement[iIdx] + aMatrix_K_mpc[iIdx, jIdx] * aStateDeviation[jIdx];
    END_FOR;
    aControlIncrement[iIdx] := aControlIncrement[iIdx] + aMatrix_K_ff[iIdx, 1] * rDisturbance_DeltaQ_m3h
                                                    + aMatrix_K_ff[iIdx, 2] * rDisturbance_DeltaT_degC;
END_FOR;

(* Closed-Loop Actuator Integration with Slew-Rate Limiting & Anti-Windup Boundary Projections *)
IF (iState = 50) OR (iState = 90) THEN
    (* 1. BMED Rectifier Current Density Demand *)
    rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 := rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2 + aControlIncrement[1];

    (* Graceful degradation derating: Clamp current to 65% if membrane scaling detected *)
    IF bMembraneScaleDetected OR (iState = 90) THEN
        IF (rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 > (c_rMaxCurrentDensity_Am2 * 0.65)) THEN
            rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 := c_rMaxCurrentDensity_Am2 * 0.65;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 > c_rMaxCurrentDensity_Am2) THEN
            rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 := c_rMaxCurrentDensity_Am2;
        ELSIF (rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 < c_rMinCurrentDensity_Am2) THEN
            rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 := c_rMinCurrentDensity_Am2;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Apply Slew Rate Limiter on Current Density (max 25.0 A/m2/s) *)
    rDeltaCurrent := rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 - rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2;
    IF (rDeltaCurrent > (c_rMaxSlewCurrent_Am2_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s)) THEN
        rDeltaCurrent := c_rMaxSlewCurrent_Am2_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    ELSIF (rDeltaCurrent < (-c_rMaxSlewCurrent_Am2_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s)) THEN
        rDeltaCurrent := -c_rMaxSlewCurrent_Am2_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    END_IF;
    rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2 + rDeltaCurrent;
    rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2    := rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2;

    (* 2. Vacuum Extraction Train VFD Speed Demand *)
    rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct := rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct + aControlIncrement[2];

    (* Restrict vacuum speed if flash pressure approaches boiling margin *)
    IF (rVotedFlashPress_mbar <= rMinPermissibleFlashPress_mbar) THEN
        rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct := rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct - 2.5; (* Back off vacuum speed *)
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct := 15.0;                      (* Modulate bleed valve *)
    ELSE
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    IF (rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct > 100.0) THEN rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct := 100.0;
    ELSIF (rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct < 15.0) THEN rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct := 15.0;
    END_IF;

    rDeltaVacSpeed := rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct - rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct;
    IF (rDeltaVacSpeed > (c_rMaxSlewVacuum_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s)) THEN
        rDeltaVacSpeed := c_rMaxSlewVacuum_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    ELSIF (rDeltaVacSpeed < (-c_rMaxSlewVacuum_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s)) THEN
        rDeltaVacSpeed := -c_rMaxSlewVacuum_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    END_IF;
    rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct + rDeltaVacSpeed;
    rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct    := rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct;

    (* 3. Flash Stripper Bottoms Extraction Pump VFD Speed Demand *)
    rTargetBottomsSpeed_pct := rPrevBottomsSpeed_pct + aControlIncrement[3];
    IF (rTargetBottomsSpeed_pct > 100.0) THEN rTargetBottomsSpeed_pct := 100.0;
    ELSIF (rTargetBottomsSpeed_pct < 10.0) THEN rTargetBottomsSpeed_pct := 10.0;
    END_IF;

    rDeltaPumpSpeed := rTargetBottomsSpeed_pct - rPrevBottomsSpeed_pct;
    IF (rDeltaPumpSpeed > (c_rMaxSlewPump_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s)) THEN
        rDeltaPumpSpeed := c_rMaxSlewPump_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    ELSIF (rDeltaPumpSpeed < (-c_rMaxSlewPump_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s)) THEN
        rDeltaPumpSpeed := -c_rMaxSlewPump_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    END_IF;
    rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := rPrevBottomsSpeed_pct + rDeltaPumpSpeed;
    rPrevBottomsSpeed_pct    := rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct;

    (* 4. Alkaline Dosing Ratio for Effluent Neutralization *)
    rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio := 0.85 + (0.05 * (7.80 - rDischargeEffluentPH_pH));
    IF (rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio > 1.20) THEN rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio := 1.20;
    ELSIF (rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio < 0.60) THEN rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio := 0.60;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: ISA-88 CONTINUOUS MULTI-STAGE PHASE STATE MACHINE
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
tStateStepTimer(IN := (iState = iPreviousState), PT := T#24H);
iPreviousState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* PHASE: IDLE / SYSTEM STANDBY *)
        rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct     := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct    := 100.0;   (* Column vented to atmosphere *)
        rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct    := 0.0;
        rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio     := 0.0;
        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd        := FALSE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd      := FALSE;
        bVacuumPumpTrainCmd         := FALSE;
        bCondenserChillerCmd        := FALSE;
        bVacuumBreakValveCmd        := FALSE;
        bEffluentDischargeDivertCmd := FALSE;

        IF bEnable AND bEStopOk AND bStartCapture AND NOT bSystemAlarm THEN
            wSystemStatusWord := 16#0001;       (* Starting Phase *)
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* PHASE: SEAWATER INTAKE & SYSTEM HYDRAULIC PRIMING *)
        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd        := TRUE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd      := TRUE;
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct    := 100.0;
        bCondenserChillerCmd        := TRUE;    (* Pre-chill the gas moisture condenser *)

        (* Await hydraulic stabilization: Seawater flow > 80 m3/h, rinse flow > 2.0 m3/h, sump level > 0.40 m *)
        IF (rSeawaterInflowRate_m3h >= 80.0) AND (rBMED_ElectrodeRinseFlow_m3h >= 2.0) AND (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m >= 0.40) THEN
            (* Start bottoms pump to establish steady recirculating level *)
            rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := 35.0;
            rPrevBottomsSpeed_pct    := 35.0;
            wSystemStatusWord        := 16#0003; (* Primed *)
            iState                   := 20;
        ELSIF tStateStepTimer.ET > T#120S THEN
            wAlarmWord2.9 := TRUE;              (* Priming timeout warning *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* PHASE: ELECTRODE RINSE DEGAS & LOW-CURRENT MEMBRANE POLARIZATION *)
        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd       := TRUE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd     := TRUE;
        bCondenserChillerCmd       := TRUE;
        rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := c_rMinCurrentDensity_Am2; (* Apply 10 A/m2 trickle current *)
        rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2    := c_rMinCurrentDensity_Am2;

        tPolarizationTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30S);
        IF tPolarizationTimer.Q AND (rBMED_H2Concentration_pctLEL < c_rWarningH2_pctLEL) THEN
            tPolarizationTimer(IN := FALSE);
            wSystemStatusWord := 16#0007;       (* Polarized *)
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

    30: (* PHASE: BMED ACIDIFICATION RAMP-UP *)
        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd       := TRUE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd     := TRUE;
        bCondenserChillerCmd       := TRUE;

        (* Ramp current density progressively to target 280 A/m2 to drive pH down toward 4.0 *)
        IF (rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 < 280.0) THEN
            rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 + (c_rMaxSlewCurrent_Am2_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
            rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2    := rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2;
        END_IF;

        (* Maintain sump liquid level via simple proportional trim before MPC takes over *)
        rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := 35.0 + 30.0 * (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m - rTargetSumpLevel_m);
        rPrevBottomsSpeed_pct    := rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct;

        (* Transition permissive: Acidified stream pH drops below 4.20 *)
        IF (rVotedAcidPH_pH <= 4.20) THEN
            wSystemStatusWord := 16#000F;       (* Acidification Established *)
            iState := 40;
        ELSIF tStateStepTimer.ET > T#180S THEN
            wAlarmWord2.9 := TRUE;              (* Acidification rate slow *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* PHASE: FLASH STRIPPER VACUUM PULL-DOWN *)
        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd       := TRUE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd     := TRUE;
        bCondenserChillerCmd       := TRUE;
        bVacuumPumpTrainCmd        := TRUE;    (* Start roots vacuum blower train *)
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct   := 0.0;     (* Seal vacuum trim bleed *)

        (* Ramp vacuum blower speed toward 65% *)
        IF (rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct < 65.0) THEN
            rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct + (c_rMaxSlewVacuum_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
            rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct    := rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct;
        END_IF;

        (* Ensure chamber pressure does not undershoot safe boiling limit *)
        IF (rVotedFlashPress_mbar <= rMinPermissibleFlashPress_mbar) THEN
            rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct := 20.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Transition permissive: Column vacuum pressure reaches target band (<= 95.0 mbar) *)
        IF (rVotedFlashPress_mbar <= 95.0) THEN
            wSystemStatusWord := 16#001F;       (* Vacuum Established *)
            iState := 50;                       (* Enter Equilibrated MPC Harvesting Mode *)
        ELSIF tStateStepTimer.ET > T#240S THEN
            wAlarmWord2.9 := TRUE;              (* Vacuum pull-down sluggish *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* PHASE: EQUILIBRATED CO2 EXTRACTION & HARVESTING (FULL MPC CLOSED LOOP) *)
        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd   := TRUE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd := TRUE;
        bVacuumPumpTrainCmd    := TRUE;
        bCondenserChillerCmd   := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord      := 16#003F;      (* Full Active Harvesting *)

        (* Layer 4 MPC is actively updating rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2, rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct, rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct *)

        (* Check for NDIR gas analyzer quality verification *)
        tGasAnalyzerStabilizeTimer(IN := (rGaseousCO2Purity_pct < 90.0), PT := T#45S);
        IF tGasAnalyzerStabilizeTimer.Q THEN
            wAlarmWord2.8 := TRUE;              (* Product gas purity below spec *)
        ELSE
            wAlarmWord2.8 := FALSE;
        END_IF;

        (* Periodic anti-scaling cycle trigger or high resistance trigger *)
        tDescaleTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4H);
        IF tDescaleTimer.Q OR bMembraneScaleDetected THEN
            tDescaleTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 60;                       (* Enter Anti-Scale Descaling Phase *)
        END_IF;

        (* Operator stop request handling *)
        IF bStopCapture THEN
            iState := 70;                       (* Enter Controlled Ramp-Down *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* PHASE: MEMBRANE SCALE PREVENTION / REVERSE POLARITY FLUSH *)
        (* Throttled operation: Reduce current density to 30 A/m2 to dissolve mineral scales *)
        rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := 30.0;
        rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2    := 30.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct    := 40.0;
        rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct       := 40.0;
        wSystemStatusWord          := 16#002F;  (* Descaling Maintenance Mode *)

        IF tStateStepTimer.ET > T#180S THEN
            bMembraneScaleDetected := FALSE;
            wAlarmWord2.1          := FALSE;
            iState := 50;                       (* Return to Steady Harvesting *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* PHASE: CONTROLLED SYSTEM RAMP-DOWN & RECOMBINATION PURGE *)
        (* Ramp down current density smoothly *)
        IF (rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 > 10.0) THEN
            rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 - (c_rMaxSlewCurrent_Am2_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
            rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2    := rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2;
        ELSE
            rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Ramp down vacuum train and bleed chamber to atmospheric pressure *)
        IF (rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct > 10.0) THEN
            rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct - (c_rMaxSlewVacuum_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
            rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct    := rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct;
        ELSE
            rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := 0.0;
            bVacuumPumpTrainCmd     := FALSE;
            rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct := 100.0;  (* Bleed column *)
        END_IF;

        (* Recombine remaining acid with excess base stream to neutralize column before stopping *)
        rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio := 1.15;

        IF (rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 = 0.0) AND (rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct = 0.0) AND (rVotedFlashPress_mbar >= 950.0) THEN
            iState := 80;                       (* Proceed to Dewatering & Standby *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* PHASE: POST-STRIP DEWATERING & SYSTEM PURGE *)
        rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := 0.0;
        bVacuumPumpTrainCmd        := FALSE;
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct   := 100.0;

        (* Evacuate column liquid sump *)
        IF (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m > 0.15) THEN
            rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := 30.0;
        ELSE
            rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := 0.0;
            bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd     := FALSE;
            bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd   := FALSE;
            bCondenserChillerCmd     := FALSE;
            wSystemStatusWord        := 16#0000;
            iState                   := 0;      (* Return to Standby IDLE *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* PHASE: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION RUN (1oo2 SENSORS OR CURRENT THROTTLED) *)
        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd   := TRUE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd := TRUE;
        bVacuumPumpTrainCmd    := TRUE;
        bCondenserChillerCmd   := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive    := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord      := 16#007F;      (* Degraded Harvesting Mode *)

        (* In degraded mode, MPC remains active but current ceiling is clamped to 65% *)
        IF bStopCapture THEN
            iState := 70;
        END_IF;

    900: (* PHASE: FAULT HOLD / SAFE RECIRCULATION *)
        (* Hold process safe: de-energize stack, stop vacuum stripping, keep seawater loop circulating *)
        rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct     := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct    := 100.0;
        bVacuumPumpTrainCmd         := FALSE;
        bEffluentDischargeDivertCmd := TRUE;    (* Divert discharge *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0F00;

        (* Sump level regulation on recirculating flow *)
        IF (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m > 0.85) THEN
            rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := 50.0;
        ELSIF (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m < 0.30) THEN
            rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        IF bResetFaults AND NOT bSystemAlarm THEN
            iState := 0;                        (* Return to Idle upon manual acknowledge *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* PHASE: SIL-3 EMERGENCY SAFETY TRIP & RAPID NITROGEN VACUUM BREAK *)
        rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct     := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct    := 100.0;
        rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct    := 0.0;
        rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio     := 0.0;
        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd        := FALSE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd      := FALSE;
        bVacuumPumpTrainCmd         := FALSE;
        bCondenserChillerCmd        := FALSE;
        bVacuumBreakValveCmd        := TRUE;    (* Fast nitrogen vacuum purge valve OPEN *)
        bEffluentDischargeDivertCmd := TRUE;    (* Isolate ocean discharge *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#FFFF; (* Critical Trip Status *)

        IF bResetFaults AND bEStopOk THEN
            bVacuumBreakValveCmd := FALSE;
            wAlarmWord1          := 16#0000;
            bSystemAlarm         := FALSE;
            iState               := 0;          (* Acknowledge trip and return to Idle *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* Update Output Sequence Step for SCADA / DCS Supervisory Tracking *)
iSequenceStep := iState;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
